title: Russia, Ukraine and the US open two-day talks in Abu Dhabi
note: The first substantive negotiations between Russia and Ukraine since February opened with US mediation and a US proposal for a long-term security architecture between Moscow and Europe. Security guarantees for Ukraine remain the main sticking point, so the talks matter as a test of whether a settlement is reachable.

title: Iran lifts its self-imposed 2,000 km limit on ballistic missile range
note: Analysts are asking whether longer-range missiles are meant to reach targets beyond the Middle East. The step comes during the ongoing war with the US and Israel and could widen the set of states that see themselves as exposed.
limitations: The summary gives expert speculation about intent; actual new missile capabilities and deployments are not confirmed. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: US president says Israel and Gulf allies must repay the cost of the Iran war
note: Analysts quoted by the outlet judge the remark to be political posturing rather than settled policy. It still signals strain over burden-sharing in the coalition fighting Iran.
limitations: The summary does not give the amount or any mechanism for repayment, and no allied response is reported. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Russian forces strike bridges and dams to isolate Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine says
note: A Ukrainian commander says Russia is targeting bridges and dams as pressure on Ukrainian defenses in Zaporizhzhia Oblast grows. Cutting logistics and water infrastructure could change the front and raise civilian risk.
limitations: Relies on a single Ukrainian military source describing Russian intent; the scale of damage is not independently verified. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for cowardice
note: The ruling reflects a Congolese army long hampered by disarray in its fight against rebel groups. It points to weak command cohesion in the eastern conflict.
limitations: The summary gives few details on the trial, the battlefield events behind it, or whether sentences will be carried out. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Bangladesh's ousted former prime minister plans a December return from exile
note: Exiled party members say the former leader, sentenced to death in absentia over deaths in the 2024 uprising, is confident of returning and has applied for a new passport. A return could sharpen the legitimacy contest and political violence risk in Bangladesh.
limitations: The return plan comes from party allies in exile and may not happen; the host country and travel route are not stated in the summary. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: UN agency says El Niño could cost the global economy up to $11 trillion
note: The UN rural development agency warns the weather pattern could also seriously hurt food security. The WMO separately expects a very strong El Niño to bring more heat and extreme weather into 2027, raising stress on food and water supplies.
